# PersonMatchAddress

An address used as match criteria — the fields the matcher reads, unlike the fuller PersonAddressInput used when writing. Only two shapes reach the matching threshold, both alongside firstName and lastName: zipOrPostalCode + dateOfBirth, or addressLine1 + zipOrPostalCode.

| Property | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `addressLine1` | string or null | Street address. Must carry both the street **number** and the street name to count toward a match: "742 Evergreen Terrace" matched, "Evergreen Terrace" did not. |
| `city` | string or null | City or town. Not part of any minimum combination. |
| `stateOrProvince` | string or null | Two or three character state or province code, e.g. "MN", "ON", "NSW". Not part of any minimum combination. |
| `zipOrPostalCode` | string or null | The zip5 that the date-of-birth and street-address combinations both require. Must agree with the person record — a right street with a wrong zip does not match. |
| `countryCode` | string or null | Two character ISO country code supported by the VAN context. Defaults to the context's country. |

`*` = required.
